h1: Ad creative briefs your designer can follow
overview: Good ads start with a clear brief. We study your product, buyers and past ads, then write a brief your designer, editor or creator can follow without guessing: the message, the hook, the shots or layouts, sizes for each placement, the words to use and the words to avoid. You get a document with examples and reference links, so the first draft is closer to what you wanted.

faq: Do you make the actual ads?
This service delivers the briefs only. If you want finished images or videos, our post design and short video edit services can make them, and we can quote the production separately.
Can the brief work with a creator or agency I already use?
Yes. The briefs are written to be handed to anyone. Tell us who will make the ads in the order form, and we adjust the level of detail and the file formats.
What do you need from me?
Product links, your best-selling items, any existing ads and what you dislike about them. If you have customer comments or reviews, send those, because real wording makes better hooks.
Will the briefs follow ad platform rules?
Yes. We write them to match Meta, Google and TikTok ad policies, so they avoid banned claims, before and after promises that are not allowed, and restricted content.
